# peakhour_bulk_redirect_list (Resource)

Manages a bulk redirect list for a domain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "peakhour_bulk_redirect_list" "example" {
  domain      = "example.com"
  name        = "legacy-pages"
  description = "Redirect retired URLs"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Domain name.
- `name` (String) Bulk redirect list name.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional description of the redirect list.

### Read-Only

- `entries_count` (Number) Number of entries in the list.
- `id` (String) Bulk redirect list identifier (domain/bulk_redirects/uuid).
- `uuid` (String) Bulk redirect list UUID (computed after creation).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import peakhour_bulk_redirect_list.example example.com/bulk_redirects/11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111
```
